# pve_node_migrate_all (Action)

Migrate all guests of a node to another node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_node_migrate_all" "example" {
  config {
  node = "pve1"
  target = "CHANGE_ME"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_node_migrate_all.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `target` (String) Target node.

### Optional

- `max_workers` (Number) Maximal number of parallel migration job. If not set, uses'max_workers' from datacenter.cfg. One of both must be set!
- `maxworkers` (Number) Maximal number of parallel migration job. If not set, uses'max_workers' from datacenter.cfg. One of both must be set!Deprecated, use 'max-workers' instead.
- `vms` (String) Only consider Guests with these IDs.
- `with_local_disks` (Boolean) Enable live storage migration for local disk
